CREATE OR REPLACE SQL SECURITY INVOKER VIEW `IMC Competition Nexus Mapping` AS
 SELECT c.id AS mapping_id,c.game_world_id,CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(c.sm_country),'') IS NULL THEN 'SINGLE' ELSE 'MULTI' END AS world_type,c.sm_country,c.competition_group,c.sm_action,CAST(c.sm_division AS CHAR(16)) AS sm_division,k.competition_key,c.IMC_View,c.updated_at,c.nexus_view
 FROM `IMC Competition Codex Global` c
 JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE(JSON_ARRAY(c.competition_key),COALESCE(c.competition_key_aliases,JSON_ARRAY())), '$[*]' COLUMNS (competition_key VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')) AS k ON TRUE
ALTER TABLE `IMC Competition Codex Global` DROP COLUMN world_type
